definition_zh: 多样的；不同的
definition_en: of many different kinds, or clearly different from one another
core_image: 一张长桌上摆着十几个地方的菜，颜色气味全不一样
scene: 长桌从这头摆到那头，盘子里的颜色没有一样重复。The city has a diverse population.
sceneCN: 这里 diverse 指「多种多样的」（第 1 个义项：种类很多）；句意是这座城市的人口构成十分多样。

senses.title: Made of many kinds
senses.definition: made up of many different kinds of people or things
senses.definitionCN: 由许多不同种类的人或物组成
senses.example: The class is diverse in age and background.
senses.exampleCN: 这个班在年龄与背景上都很杂。
senses.why: A room with many voices is harder to sum up in one word.
senses.whyCN: 满是不同声音的房间，很难用一个词概括。

senses.title: Different from something else
senses.definition: clearly unlike another thing in nature or form
senses.definitionCN: 在性质或形态上与另一物明显不一样
senses.example: Their views are diverse on this point.
senses.exampleCN: 在这一点上他们的看法各不相同。
senses.why: To differ is to turn away on a road you once shared.
senses.whyCN: 所谓不同，就是在同一条路上各自转开。

intro.en: Diverse is Latin diversus, turned aside, from divertere, to turn in different directions.
intro.cn: diverse 是拉丁语 diversus（转开），来自 divertere（转向不同方向）。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn or turn around.
items.cn: vertere 指转动或转身。

items.en: Di- pulled the turning into two directions.
items.cn: 前缀 di- 把转动拉向两个方向。

items.en: Diversus described things turned away from each other.
items.cn: diversus 描述彼此转开的东西。

items.en: English used it for things unlike in kind.
items.cn: 英语借入时说种类不相同的东西。

items.en: The sense of many kinds together grew strong.
items.cn: 后来「多种并存」的意思变强。

items.en: Today a diverse team is valued for its differences.
items.cn: 今天多元的团队正因差异而受重视。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the vertere stem, while the meaning group gathers words for many kinds.
note.cn: 形近组共享 vertere 这段词干，近义组则是几个表示种类多的词。

entries.definition: the state of having many kinds
to add more kinds to something
a turning aside, or a pleasant change
of several different kinds
more than one and not all alike
made of unlike parts put together

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a long table of unlike dishes and end with two views turning apart.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一张摆满不同菜的长桌开始，落到两种各自转开的看法。

normal.en: Di- plus verse: the roads turn in different directions.
normal.cn: di 加 verse，路朝不同方向转开。

normal.en: The market sells diverse goods from a dozen regions.
normal.cn: 这个市场卖着十几个地区的各色货物。

normal.en: A diverse team argues more and misses less.
normal.cn: 多元的团队争得更多，漏掉的更少。

normal.en: Her interests are diverse: birds, boats and old maps.
normal.cn: 她的兴趣很杂：鸟、船和旧地图。

normal.en: The two accounts are diverse in almost every detail.
normal.cn: 这两种说法几乎每个细节都不同。

abstract.en: Picture one road splitting into many smaller roads.
abstract.cn: 想象一条路分成许多小路。

abstract.en: Picture a table where no two bowls hold the same thing.
abstract.cn: 想象一张桌子，没有两只碗装同样的东西。

abstract.en: Picture two people walking off in opposite directions.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人朝相反方向走开。

examples.en: The city has a diverse population.
examples.cn: 这座城市的人口构成很多元。

examples.en: Her reading is more diverse than mine.
examples.cn: 她读的东西比我的杂得多。

examples.en: The two villages are diverse in language and food.
examples.cn: 这两个村子在语言和饮食上都不一样。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diverse 记成「各自转开」：di 表示分开，verse 表示转，路朝不同方向转开，就有了各种各样的差别。

root: 源自拉丁语 diversus，来自 divertere（转向不同方向），由 di-（分开）与 vertere（转）组成。本义是彼此转开、不朝一处，因此既指种类繁多，也指两物在性质上不同。

sensesIntro.en: From a road splitting into many to two views that no longer face the same way.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一条路分成许多条，到两种不再朝同一方向的看法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one long table where no two dishes share a colour.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张长桌，没有两道菜颜色相同。

branches.en: The first sense is many kinds standing together.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是许多种类站在一起。

branches.en: The second sense is one thing turning away from another.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是一物与另一物转开。

branches.en: Both senses begin with a turning apart.
branches.cn: 两个义项都从转开开始。

branches.en: Both make a single label feel too small.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让一个标签显得不够用。

branches.en: Only the first sense needs a crowd of kinds.
branches.cn: 只有第一个义项需要一大群种类。

intro.en: Diverse belongs to the vertere family, where Latin vertere, to turn, gives a crowd of turning words.
intro.cn: diverse 属于 vertere 一族，拉丁语 vertere（转）生出一大串表示转的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin vertere, to turn, gives diverse and divert; di- turns the two paths away from each other.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vertere（转）给出 diverse 与 divert，前缀 di- 把两条路彼此转开。

items.meaning: the state of having many kinds
items.example: The island is known for its diversity.

items.exampleCN: 这组人受过的训练很杂。

items.example: The road diversion added ten minutes.
They converted the barn into a house.
items.exampleCN: 他们把谷仓改成了住宅。

definition_zh: 使多样化；分散投资；开展多元化业务
definition_en: to make something more varied, or to spread money or activity across different areas
core_image: 一只手把同一种东西撒向好几块不同的田地
scene: 一家只卖一种农产品的家族企业决定把业务扩展到食品加工与乡村旅店。The family firm decided to diversify into food processing and rural tourism.
sceneCN: 这里指「把业务扩展到新的领域」，对应第 3 个义项：企业进入与原业务不同的产品线；句意为这家家族企业决定向食品加工与乡村旅游业多元化。画面要点：农田、加工车间、旅店招牌。

pos.zh: 使多样化；分散（投资）；开展多元化业务；增加（作物、来源等的）种类

derivatives.zh: 分散风险者；多元化经营者

senses.title: To make more varied
senses.definition: to introduce a wider range of types into something
senses.definitionCN: 把更广泛的类型引入某事物
senses.example: The school diversified its reading list.
senses.exampleCN: 学校使阅读书单更加多样。
senses.why: The verb is the general action behind the noun: one line of things is turned into several lines.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词是名词背后的一般动作：一条线上的一类东西被转成好几条线。

senses.title: To spread investments
senses.definition: to put money into several assets instead of one
senses.definitionCN: 把钱投入多项资产而不是只投一项
senses.example: Retirees should diversify before markets turn.
senses.exampleCN: 退休者应在市场转向之前先分散投资。
senses.why: Finance turns the general act into risk management: many assets mean many chances instead of one.
senses.whyCN: 金融把这个一般动作变成风险管理：多项资产意味着多个机会而不是一个。

senses.title: To enter new lines of business
senses.definition: for a company, to expand into products or services beyond its original line
senses.definitionCN: 企业扩展到原业务之外的产品或服务
senses.example: The chain diversified into coffee shops.
senses.exampleCN: 这家连锁企业扩展到咖啡店业务。
senses.why: A firm that adds a second line is literally adding kinds to its basket of revenue.
senses.whyCN: 增添第二条业务线的公司，实际上是在其收入篮子里加上新的种类。

senses.title: To vary products or markets
senses.definition: to change the mix of goods sold or the markets served
senses.definitionCN: 改变所售商品或所服务市场的组合
senses.example: The exporter diversified its markets across Asia.
senses.exampleCN: 这家出口商在亚洲各地分散市场。
senses.why: Here the added kinds are goods and destinations, so the verb shifts from entering a line to changing the mix.
senses.whyCN: 这里增添的种类是商品与目的地，动词因此从「进入一条线」转为「改变组合」。

senses.title: To broaden an economy
senses.definition: to reduce a region's dependence on one industry
senses.definitionCN: 降低一个地区对单一产业的依赖
senses.example: The province diversified away from timber.
senses.exampleCN: 该省从木材业转向多元化。
senses.why: The verb scales a company strategy up to a whole region: one industry is replaced by several.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词把企业策略放大到整个地区：一个产业被好几个产业取代。

senses.title: To increase genetic variety
senses.definition: to widen the range of genes in a population or crop
senses.definitionCN: 扩大种群或作物的基因范围
senses.example: Plant breeders diversify wheat to resist disease.
senses.exampleCN: 育种者使小麦多样化以抗病。
senses.why: Breeding uses the same act without markets: more kinds in the gene pool mean fewer total failures.
senses.whyCN: 育种在没有市场的情况下使用同一动作：基因库里种类更多，整体失败就更少。

senses.title: To expand one's range of activity
senses.definition: for a person or group, to take on new kinds of work or interest
senses.definitionCN: 个人或团体承担新的工作或兴趣种类
senses.example: She diversified her practice to include family law.
senses.exampleCN: 她扩展业务范围，纳入了家庭法。
senses.why: A career or practice can be a portfolio of activities, so the verb applies to a person's bundle of work.
senses.whyCN: 职业或业务可以是一组活动，因此这个动词也能用于一个人的工作束。

senses.title: To grow several crops
senses.definition: to replace a single crop with several on the same farm
senses.definitionCN: 在同一农场上以多种作物取代单一作物
senses.example: The cooperative diversified into fruit and nuts.
senses.exampleCN: 合作社多样化种植水果与坚果。
senses.why: The field is the simplest basket: several crops spread the risk of weather and price.
senses.whyCN: 田地是最简单的篮子：几种作物分散天气与价格风险。

senses.title: To change the mix of sources
senses.definition: to add different sources of supply or energy
senses.definitionCN: 增加不同的供应或能源来源
senses.example: The grid diversified into wind and solar power.
senses.exampleCN: 电网向风能与太阳能多元化。
senses.why: Sources are supplies, so the same verb says: do not depend on one well, one pipe or one country.
senses.whyCN: 来源就是供应，所以同一个动词表达：不要只依赖一口井、一条管道或一个国家。

intro.en: Diversify is an English verb formed from Latin diversus 'turned apart' and facere 'to make'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: diversify 是英语动词，由拉丁语 diversus「转向别处」与 facere「制造」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn; its participle supplied the idea of being turned in another direction.
items.cn: vertere 意为转动；它的分词形式提供了「被转向另一方向」的意思。

items.en: Diversus meant turned apart or various, the direct ancestor of diverse and diversity.
items.cn: diversus 意为被转开或多样的，是 diverse 与 diversity 的直接祖先。

items.en: Diversificare joined that adjective with facere 'to make' to mean to make different or varied.
items.cn: diversificare 把这个形容词与 facere「制造」结合，意为使不同、使多样。

items.en: French used the verb in ordinary speech, and English borrowed it in the seventeenth century as diversify.
items.cn: 法语在日常语言中使用这个动词，英语在十七世纪以 diversify 的形式借入。

items.en: Modern finance applied the verb to holdings and modern industry applied it to products, markets and regions.
items.cn: 现代金融把这个动词用于持有资产，现代产业则把它用于产品、市场与地区。

note.en: The first group is built on the same turning root and is often confused with it; the second group contains verbs of widening or varying.
note.cn: 第一组建立在同一个「转」的词根上，常被混淆；第二组是表示扩大或变化的动词。

entries.definition: A change of route or an entertainment; it turns one thing away rather than adding kinds.
entries.definitionCN: 改道或消遣；它把一样东西转开，而不是增加种类。

entries.definition: The state of being varied; it is the result, while diversify is the action that creates it.
entries.definitionCN: 多样的状态；它是结果，而 diversify 是创造它的动作。

entries.definition: Of many different kinds; it describes a set, not the process of changing it.
entries.definitionCN: 许多不同种类的；它描述一个集合，而不是改变它的过程。

entries.definition: To change the course of something; it does not mean to multiply its kinds.
entries.definitionCN: 改变某物的方向；不表示增加其种类。

entries.definition: To make or become different over time; vary stresses change, diversify stresses adding kinds.
entries.definitionCN: 使或变得不同；vary 强调变化，diversify 强调增加种类。

entries.definition: To make wider in scope; it stresses extent rather than the number of kinds.
entries.definitionCN: 使范围更宽；强调广度而非种类的数量。

entries.definition: To grow in size or reach; expansion may stay within one business, while diversification must cross boundaries.
entries.definitionCN: 在规模或范围上增长；扩张可以在同一业务内，而多元化必须跨界。

entries.definition: To distribute over an area; in finance it describes the physical result of diversifying.
entries.definitionCN: 分布到一片区域；在金融中描述分散化的实际结果。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin pieces, real compounds and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁成分、真实复合词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: The word is make plus turned apart: to diversify is to make things head in different directions.
normal.cn: 这个词是「制造」加「转向别处」：多元化就是让事物朝不同方向走。

normal.en: Money diversifies into assets, a firm into products, a region into industries, a farm into crops.
normal.cn: 资金分散到资产，企业扩展到产品，地区扩展到产业，农场扩展到作物。

normal.en: The fixed phrase diversify into marks the new field being entered.
normal.cn: 表示「扩展到某一领域」的固定说法标出正在进入的新领域。

normal.en: Diversify away from marks the old dependence being reduced.
normal.cn: 表示「从某一领域转向别处」的说法标出正在减少的旧依赖。

normal.en: The noun diversification and the adjective diversified come from this verb, not the other way round.
normal.cn: 名词 diversification 与形容词 diversified 都从这个动词而来，而不是反过来。

abstract.en: Picture one hand scattering the same seed over several fields, so no single storm can take the whole harvest.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把同一种种子撒向好几块田，任何一场风暴都拿不走全部收成。

abstract.en: Picture a single stream split into several channels, each able to supply water if another dries.
abstract.cn: 想象一条水流分成几道渠，任何一条干了，其余仍能供水。

abstract.en: Picture a person's work splitting into several skills, so one closed door does not end the career.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人的工作分成几项技能，一扇门关上并不终结整个职业。

examples.en: Farmers were advised to diversify their crops after the drought.
examples.cn: 干旱之后，农民被建议使作物多样化。

examples.en: The fund diversifies across regions and industries.
examples.cn: 该基金在地域与行业上分散投资。

examples.en: The city hopes to diversify away from tourism.
examples.cn: 这座城市希望摆脱对旅游业的依赖而走向多元化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「使分成许多样」——把投资、产品、作物都分成好几路 → 多元化

root: 由拉丁语 diversus「转向别处的、多样的」与 facere「制造」构成，经法语进入英语；核心动作是使一类事物变成多类。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses apply one act to different objects: reading lists, portfolios, business lines, markets, regional economies, genes, careers, crops and energy sources.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项把同一个动作用到不同对象上：书单、投资组合、业务线、市场、地区经济、基因、职业、作物与能源来源。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand scattering the same seed across several fields.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把同一种种子撒向好几块田。

branches.en: GENERAL ACTION: a single range is deliberately widened into several kinds.
branches.cn: 一般动作：单一范围被有意拓宽成好几种。

branches.en: FINANCIAL ACTION: money is placed in many assets instead of one.
branches.cn: 金融动作：资金被放进多项资产而不是只有一项。

branches.en: NEW WORK: a firm adds business lines and a person adds kinds of practice.
branches.cn: 新工作：公司增添业务线，个人增添业务种类。

branches.en: WIDENING MIX: products, regional industries and supply sources are all re-mixed.
branches.cn: 拓宽组合：产品、地区产业与供应来源都被重新调配。

branches.en: NATURAL AND FIELD VARIETY: genes and crops are varied so one disease cannot take everything.
branches.cn: 自然与田地的多样：基因与作物被多样化，使一种病害拿不走全部。

intro.en: Diversify is a transparent Latin-derived verb: a turning root, a making suffix, and a family of related nouns and adjectives.
intro.cn: diversify 是一个结构清楚的拉丁来源动词：一个「转」的词根、一个「制造」的后缀，以及一族相关名词与形容词。

latinIntro.en: The root vertere 'to turn' also builds convert, reverse and versatile; diversus adds the sense of turning apart.
latinIntro.cn: 词根表示「转」，也构成 convert、reverse 与 versatile；diversus 增添「转向别处」的意思。

items.example: The root appears in reverse and version.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根出现在反转与版本等词里。

items.example: To clarify is to make clear.

items.meaning: made varied, or having entered new lines
items.meaningCN: 已多样化的，或已进入新业务线的
items.example: The economy is more diversified now.

items.exampleCN: 他们正在使供应商多样化。
他们服务于一个多元市场。

items.meaning: a person or thing that diversifies
items.meaningCN: 进行多样化的人或事物
items.exampleCN: 黄金充当一种分散工具。

latinEntries.meaning: able to turn to many uses

derivatives.zh: 分散风险者；多元化经营者

definition_zh: n. 转移；转向；改道；绕行路；消遣；分散注意力的举动
definition_en: the act of turning something aside from its course, a temporary detour, or an activity that entertains
core_image: 一条被推出旧河床、进入新河道的水流；橙色箭头把车流指向一条窄巷；雨天午后的一副纸牌和一张棋盘；院子另一头炸响的一枚爆竹
scene: 主路挖开了，橙色箭头把车流引向一条窄巷。Follow the diversion past the bridge works.
sceneCN: 这里 diversion 是「绕行路」（第 2 个义项：主路封闭时临时使用的路线）；句意：沿着绕行路经过桥梁施工段。图中可辨识物件：橙色箭头、挖开的路面、窄巷、施工围挡。

pos.zh: 转移；转向；改道；绕行路；消遣；分散注意力的举动

collocations.phrase: a diversion from the main road

senses.title: Turning aside
senses.definition: the act of changing the direction, course or use of something
senses.definitionCN: （名词）指改变某物的方向、路线或用途
senses.example: The diversion of the river took two years.
senses.exampleCN: 河流改道花了两年。
senses.why: A river pushed out of its old bed into a new channel.
senses.whyCN: 一条被推出旧河床、进入新河道的水流。

senses.title: A temporary detour
senses.definition: a route used for a short time while the main road is closed
senses.definitionCN: （名词）主路封闭时临时使用的路线
senses.example: Follow the diversion past the bridge works.
senses.exampleCN: 沿着绕行路经过桥梁施工段。
senses.why: Orange arrows pointing traffic onto a narrow lane.
senses.whyCN: 橙色箭头把车流指向一条窄巷。

senses.title: Pleasant entertainment
senses.definition: an activity that gives amusement or relaxation
senses.definitionCN: （名词）带来娱乐或放松的活动
senses.example: The hotel offers evening diversions for guests.
senses.exampleCN: 酒店为客人提供晚间消遣。
senses.why: A deck of cards and a chess board on a rainy afternoon.
senses.whyCN: 雨天午后的一副纸牌和一张棋盘。

senses.title: A distracting move
senses.definition: something done to draw attention away from what matters
senses.definitionCN: （名词）为把注意力从要紧事上引开而做的举动
senses.example: He created a diversion so the others could slip out.
senses.exampleCN: 他制造了一个幌子，好让其他人溜出去。
senses.why: A firecracker popping at the far end of the yard.
senses.whyCN: 院子另一头炸响的一枚爆竹。

senses.title: Redirected resources
senses.definition: the act of moving money or supplies to a different purpose
senses.definitionCN: （名词）把资金或物资转作别的用途
senses.example: The diversion of funds was reported to the board.
senses.exampleCN: 资金挪用一事已上报董事会。
senses.why: A pipe carrying water from one tank into another.

intro.en: Diversion comes from Latin divertere, to turn aside, built from di- plus vertere, to turn; the noun suffix -ion turns the action into a thing you can name.
intro.cn: diversion 来自拉丁语 divertere「转到一边」，由 di- 加 vertere「转」组成；名词后缀 -ion 把这个动作变成一件可以指称的事。

items.en: Latin vertere means to turn.
items.cn: 拉丁语 vertere 意为转。

items.en: Divertere means to turn aside or away.
items.cn: divertere 意为转到一边或转开。

items.en: The related noun versio means a turning.
items.cn: 相关名词 versio 意为一次转动。

items.en: Old French diversion carries the sense of turning away.
items.cn: 古法语 diversion 带有转开的意思。

items.en: The word comes to mean a temporary route around road works.
items.cn: 这个词转而指绕过道路施工的临时路线。

items.en: Diversion also names entertainment and a distracting move.
items.cn: diversion 也指消遣与分散注意力的举动。

note.en: Diversion is a turning aside; its look-alikes share the turn root, and its neighbours name the route, the pulled attention and the fun.
note.cn: diversion 是一次转开；形近词共用「转」的词根，近义词则分别指那条路、被拉开的注意力和那份乐趣。

definition_zh: 多样性；差异
definition_en: the state of including many different kinds of people or things
core_image: 一片林子里高矮粗细不同的树，各自朝着光长
scene: 林子从山脚一直铺到水边，树种多得记不住。The forest is famous for its diversity of birds.
sceneCN: 这里 diversity 指「多样性」（第 1 个义项：种类繁多）；句意是这片森林以鸟类多样而闻名。

senses.title: Many kinds in one place
senses.definition: the state of including many different kinds of people or things
senses.definitionCN: 同一个地方包含许多不同种类的人或物
senses.example: The island is known for its diversity of plants.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛以植物多样著称。
senses.why: A forest is healthiest where no single tree takes the light.
senses.whyCN: 林子里没有一种树独占阳光时，才最健康。

senses.title: A clear difference between things
senses.definition: the quality of being unlike something else
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物不相同的性质
senses.example: There is real diversity between the two traditions.
senses.exampleCN: 这两种传统之间有真正的差异。
senses.why: Difference becomes a value once people choose to keep it.
senses.whyCN: 差异一旦被人选择保留，就成了价值。

intro.en: Diversity is Latin diversitas, difference, from diversus, turned apart.
intro.cn: diversity 是拉丁语 diversitas（差异），来自 diversus（转开）。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn, as a wheel turns.
items.cn: vertere 指转动，像轮子那样转。

items.en: Diversus described paths turned away from each other.
items.cn: diversus 描述彼此转开的路。

items.en: Diversitas named the state of being unlike.
items.cn: diversitas 指彼此不相同的状态。

items.en: English used it for difference in kind.
items.cn: 英语借入时指种类上的不同。

items.en: The word became a public value in schools and firms.
items.cn: 到了现代，它成了学校与机构公开看重的价值。

items.en: Today it covers species, voices, diets and ideas.
items.cn: 今天它可以指物种、声音、饮食与想法。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the vers stem, while the meaning group names other kinds of variety.
note.cn: 形近组共享 vers 这段词干，近义组则是几种表示繁多的词。

entries.definition: of many different kinds
to make more varied
a turning aside or a pastime
a collection of unlike kinds
the spread of things from one end to another
entries.definitionCN: 事物从一端到另一端的跨度

entries.definition: the way two things are not alike

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a forest of unlike trees and end with two traditions that refuse to merge.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一片高矮不同的林子开始，落到两种不肯合一的传统。

normal.en: Di- plus vers plus -ity: many turnings held in one place.
normal.cn: di 加 vers 再加 ity，许多转向被收在同一处。

normal.en: The report measures diversity in ten city schools.
normal.cn: 这份报告衡量了十所城市学校的多样性。

normal.en: Bees depend on the diversity of flowers in a meadow.
normal.cn: 蜜蜂依赖草地里花种类的多样。

normal.en: A diversity of voices made the meeting longer and better.
normal.cn: 意见多元让会议更长也更好。

normal.en: The island guards its diversity against new species.
normal.cn: 这座岛守护自己的多样，防范外来物种。

abstract.en: Picture trees of every height reaching for the same light.
abstract.cn: 想象高矮不一的树都朝同一片光长。

abstract.en: Picture a market stall with twenty kinds of grain.
abstract.cn: 想象一个摊子上摆着二十种谷物。

abstract.en: Picture two rivers running side by side without joining.
abstract.cn: 想象两条河并流却始终不合。

examples.en: The forest is famous for its diversity of birds.
examples.cn: 这片森林以鸟类多样而闻名。

examples.en: The report calls for diversity in hiring.
examples.cn: 报告呼吁在招聘中重视多元。

examples.en: Diversity of opinion keeps a team honest.
examples.cn: 意见的多样让团队保持诚实。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diversity 记成「转开之后留下的多」：di 表示分开，vers 表示转，许多东西各自转开，同一处就显出丰富的种类与差异。

root: 源自拉丁语 diversitas，来自 diversus（转开），词根 vertere 意为转。本义是彼此转向不同方向的状态，后来指种类繁多，现代又成为一种被公开看重的价值，用于物种、文化、意见等话题。

sensesIntro.en: From a forest where every tree leans its own way to a value that people choose to protect.
sensesIntro.cn: 从每棵树各自斜向一边的林子，到人们选择去保护的某种价值。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stand of trees of every height, each leaning towards the same light.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片高矮不一的树，各自朝同一片光倾斜。

branches.en: The first sense is many kinds sharing one place.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是许多种类共处一地。

branches.en: The second sense is the gap between two of them.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是其中两者之间的差别。

branches.en: Both senses grow from things turned apart.
branches.cn: 两个义项都从转开的事物里长出来。

branches.en: Both are measured by counting what differs.
branches.cn: 两个义项都靠数不同的东西来衡量。

branches.en: Only the second sense can be a single pair.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项可以只是一对事物。

intro.en: Diversity sits in the vertere family, where Latin vertere, to turn, holds a large group of words.
intro.cn: diversity 属于 vertere 一族，拉丁语 vertere（转）撑起一大组词。

latinIntro.en: Latin vertere, to turn, gives diversity and divert; -ity turns the turning into a lasting state.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vertere（转）给出 diversity 与 divert，后缀 -ity 把转动变成一种持续的状态。

definition_zh: v. 使转向；使改道；转移；转用；使分心；使娱乐
definition_en: to make something change direction or use, to draw attention away, or to entertain someone
core_image: 工人在被堵住的河流旁挖出一条新河道；一根把水从一只水箱引到另一只的管子；一只手在视野边缘挥动一块亮色布；一架从大雾跑道旁侧转离开的飞机
scene: 机场广播响起，大雾把跑道盖住了。The flight was diverted to another airport.
sceneCN: 这里 divert 是「使改航」（第 5 个义项：让交通工具改去别的目的地）；句意：航班被改航到另一座机场。图中可辨识物件：广播喇叭、雾中的跑道、侧转的飞机、另一座机场的塔台。

pos.zh: 使转向；使改道；转移；转用；使分心；使娱乐

senses.title: Change the course
senses.definition: to make a river, road or traffic follow a different route
senses.definitionCN: （动词）使河流、道路或车流走另一条路线
senses.example: They diverted the river around the site.
senses.exampleCN: 他们让河流绕过工地。
senses.why: Workers cutting a new channel beside a blocked river.
senses.whyCN: 工人在被堵住的河流旁挖出一条新河道。

senses.title: Turn to a new use
senses.definition: to send money, goods or effort to a different purpose
senses.definitionCN: （动词）把资金、物资或精力转用于别的用途
senses.example: The funds were diverted to emergency repairs.
senses.exampleCN: 资金被转用于紧急维修。
senses.why: A pipe carrying water from one tank into another.
senses.whyCN: 一根把水从一只水箱引到另一只的管子。

senses.title: Draw attention away
senses.definition: to take the mind or the eyes off something
senses.definitionCN: （动词）把心思或目光从某事上引开
senses.example: Nothing could divert her from the task.
senses.exampleCN: 什么也不能使她放下手头的工作。
senses.why: A hand waving a bright cloth at the edge of vision.
senses.whyCN: 一只手在视野边缘挥动一块亮色布。

senses.title: Give pleasure
senses.definition: to amuse someone or fill their time enjoyably
senses.definitionCN: （动词）逗某人开心、让某人愉快地打发时间
senses.example: The clown diverted the children for an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 小丑逗孩子们乐了一个小时。
senses.why: A deck of cards and a chess board on a rainy afternoon.
senses.whyCN: 雨天午后的一副纸牌和一张棋盘。

senses.title: Send to another place
senses.definition: to make a vehicle go to a different destination
senses.definitionCN: （动词）让交通工具改去别的目的地
senses.example: The flight was diverted to another airport.
senses.exampleCN: 航班被改航到另一座机场。
senses.why: A plane banking away from a fogged runway.
senses.whyCN: 一架从大雾跑道旁侧转离开的飞机。

items.en: English divert first means to turn something aside.

items.en: The word gains the sense of entertaining the mind.

definition_zh: 分开；分配；除
definition_en: to separate something into parts, to share things out, or to find how many times one number fits another
core_image: 一块面饼被刀从中间按下，两半慢慢分开
scene: 桌上那块饼还热着，刀已经按在正中。Divide the cake into eight equal pieces.
sceneCN: 这里 divide 指「分开」（第 1 个义项：把整体切成几份）；句意是把蛋糕分成八块一样大的。

senses.title: To cut a whole into parts
senses.definition: to separate something into two or more parts
senses.definitionCN: 把一样东西分成两份或更多
senses.example: Divide the dough into two equal balls.
senses.exampleCN: 把面团分成两个一样大的球。
senses.why: A whole resists, then gives along one line.
senses.whyCN: 一个整体先是顶着，随后沿着一条线让开。

senses.title: To share out among people
senses.definition: to give parts of something to different people
senses.definitionCN: 把东西的一部分给不同的人
senses.example: They divided the money among the four of them.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把钱四个人分了。
senses.why: Sharing turns one amount into several claims.
senses.whyCN: 分配把一笔数目变成几份主张。

senses.title: To find how many times one fits another
senses.definition: to calculate how many times one number is contained in another
senses.definitionCN: 算出一个数里含有另一个数多少次
senses.example: Ten divided by two is five.
senses.exampleCN: 十除以二等于五。
senses.why: Division asks how many times one thing fits inside another.
senses.whyCN: 除法问的是一个东西能装进另一个几次。

intro.en: Divide comes from Latin dividere, to force apart, from dis-, apart, and a root meaning to separate.
intro.cn: divide 来自拉丁语 dividere（强行分开），由 dis-（分开）与表示分离的词根构成。

items.en: Dividere meant to part or force things asunder.
items.cn: dividere 指分开或把东西强行拆开。

items.en: A divider marked where the land was cut.
items.cn: divider 指标出土地被切之处的界物。

items.en: Dividere also covered sharing among heirs.
items.cn: dividere 也指在继承人之间分配。

items.en: English used it for cutting and for sharing.
items.cn: 英语借入后既指切开，也指分享。

items.en: Arithmetic gave it the sense of finding a quotient.
items.cn: 算术给了它求商的意思。

items.en: Today a road, a bill and a nation can all divide.

root: 源自拉丁语 dividere（强行分开），由 dis-（分开）与表示分离的词根组成。本义是把整体切开，后来扩展到把东西分给众人，又进入算术表示除法，也用于道路、账单、意见等被分成几部分。

definition_en: a share of profit paid to shareholders, or a number to be divided
core_image: 一只钱袋被分成几小袋，递给持有股份的人
scene: 公司年报公布后，董事会决定把更多利润以现金分给持股人。The board raised the dividend after a strong year.
sceneCN: 这里指「分给股东的利润」，对应第 1 个义项：公司从利润中按股份支付给股东的款项；句意为业绩强劲的一年后，董事会提高了股息。画面要点：年报、钱袋、股东名单。

pos.zh: 股息；红利；被除数；回报；保单红利

senses.title: A share of profit paid to shareholders
senses.definition: a part of a company's profit distributed to its shareholders
senses.definitionCN: 公司利润中分给股东的一部分
senses.example: The company pays a dividend twice a year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司每年派发两次股息。
senses.why: The word literally means that which is to be divided: profit is cut into portions and one portion goes to each share.
senses.whyCN: 这个词字面上指「应当被分掉的东西」：利润被切成几份，每份股份得一份。

senses.title: An interim or final payment
senses.titleCN: 期中或期末派发的股息
senses.definition: a dividend paid at a scheduled point in the financial year
senses.definitionCN: 在财年某个既定节点支付的股息
senses.example: The interim dividend rose to eight cents.
senses.exampleCN: 期中股息升至八分。
senses.why: The same share of profit is named by its timing, since a payment can be made halfway through the year or at its close.
senses.whyCN: 同一份利润按支付时点得名，因为款项可以在年中或年末支付。

senses.title: A benefit from an action
senses.definition: an advantage or return that results from effort or investment
senses.definitionCN: 由努力或投入产生的益处或回报
senses.example: The training paid dividends in fewer accidents.
senses.exampleCN: 这项培训在减少事故上带来了回报。
senses.why: Profit is abstracted from money to any good result, so an effort can be said to pay dividends even without shares.
senses.whyCN: 利润从金钱抽象为任何好结果，所以即使没有股份，一项努力也能说带来回报。

senses.title: A number to be divided
senses.definition: the number that is divided by another in arithmetic
senses.definitionCN: 算术中被另一个数除的数
senses.example: In twelve divided by three, twelve is the dividend.
senses.exampleCN: 在十二除以三中，十二是被除数。
senses.why: This is the oldest literal sense: the quantity that is cut up by division, before finance borrowed the name.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的字面义：被除法切分的数量，金融后来借用了这个名字。

senses.title: An insurance policy dividend
senses.definition: a share of surplus returned to holders of certain insurance policies
senses.definitionCN: 某些保险保单持有人分得的盈余份额
senses.example: The mutual insurer returned a dividend to policyholders.
senses.exampleCN: 这家互助保险公司向保单持有人返还了红利。
senses.why: An insurer's surplus is divided among the people who funded it, so the profit-share sense moves from shares to policies.
senses.whyCN: 保险公司的盈余在出资人之间分配，利润份额义于是从股份转到保单。

senses.title: A cooperative patronage dividend
senses.titleCN: 合作社按交易量分配的盈余
senses.definition: a share of a cooperative's surplus returned according to members' trade
senses.definitionCN: 合作社按成员交易额返还的盈余份额
senses.example: The farmers' cooperative paid a patronage dividend.
senses.exampleCN: 农民合作社支付了按交易额计算的盈余。
senses.why: Cooperative members are owners and customers at once, so surplus is divided by how much each used the business.
senses.whyCN: 合作社成员同时是所有者与顾客，所以盈余按各人使用企业的多少来分。

senses.title: A dividend paid in shares
senses.definition: a distribution made by issuing additional shares instead of cash
senses.definitionCN: 通过增发股份而非现金进行的分配
senses.example: The company chose a stock dividend to keep cash.
senses.exampleCN: 公司选择股票股利以保留现金。
senses.why: The portion is still divided out, but the portion consists of new shares rather than money.
senses.whyCN: 分出去的仍然是份额，只是这一份由新股份而不是现金构成。

senses.title: A dividend paid in cash
senses.definition: a distribution paid directly in money
senses.definitionCN: 直接以金钱支付的分配
senses.example: Investors prefer a steady cash dividend.
senses.exampleCN: 投资者偏好稳定的现金股息。
senses.why: This is the plainest financial reading: profit is divided and the holder receives money rather than paper.
senses.whyCN: 这是最朴素的金融读法：利润被分开，持有人收到的是钱而不是纸。

intro.en: Dividend comes from a Latin gerundive meaning that which is to be divided; the arithmetic sense is older than the financial one. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: dividend 出自拉丁语动形词，意为「应当被分掉的东西」；算术义早于金融义。年代均为约数。

items.en: Dividere meant to force apart, cleave or distribute; it is generally analysed as dis- 'apart' plus a second element meaning to separate, though the deeper origin of that element is source uncertain.
items.cn: dividere 意为分开、劈开、分配；一般分析为 dis-「分开」加一个表示「分离」的成分，但该成分更深的来源不确定。

items.en: The gerundive dividendum meant that which is to be divided, a form used in arithmetic and in sharing out amounts.
items.cn: 动形词 dividendum 意为「应当被分掉的东西」，用于算术与分配数额。

items.en: English arithmetic books used dividend for the number to be divided, the sense that still survives in mathematics.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语算术书用 dividend 指被除数，这一义项至今留在数学中。

items.en: Joint-stock companies began to divide surplus profit among shareholders and called each portion a dividend.
items.cn: 合股公司开始把剩余利润分给股东，并把每一份称为 dividend。

items.en: Insurance, cooperatives and stock-based payments extended the word to policyholders, members and shares issued instead of cash.
items.cn: 保险、合作社与以股代现的支付方式，把这个词扩展到保单持有人、合作社成员与增发股份。

note.en: The first group is built on the same dividing root and is easily confused; the second group names other kinds of payment or return.
note.cn: 第一组建立在同一个「分开」的词根上，容易混淆；第二组是其他类型的支付或回报。

entries.definition: The number by which another is divided; the dividend is above the line, the divisor below it.
entries.definitionCN: 用来除另一个数的数；被除数在除号上方，除数在下方。

entries.definition: The act or operation of dividing; it is the process, while a dividend is one of the quantities involved.
entries.definitionCN: 划分或除的动作；它是过程，而 dividend 是参与其中的一个量。

entries.definition: To separate or share out; the verb names the action that produces a dividend.
entries.definitionCN: 分开或分配；动词表示产生股息或被除数的动作。

entries.definition: A single person, literally one that cannot be divided; it shares the root but has no sense of a portion paid out.
entries.definitionCN: 单个的人，字面是「不可再分者」；共享词根，但没有分出份额的意思。

entries.definition: A sum of money paid out, from insurance, gambling or a company; it is broader than dividend.
entries.definitionCN: 从保险、博彩或公司付出的款项；比股息更宽泛。

entries.definition: The formal sharing out of money or assets; a dividend is one kind of distribution.
entries.definitionCN: 对金钱或资产的正式分配；股息是分配的一种。

entries.definition: An extra payment, often discretionary; a dividend follows ownership, while a bonus often follows performance.
entries.definitionCN: 额外支付的款项，常出于酌情；股息跟随所有权，奖金常跟随业绩。

entries.definition: The total gain from an investment, including interest and price change; a dividend is only one part of a return.
entries.definitionCN: 投资的总收益，包括利息与价格变化；股息只是回报的一部分。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin meaning that which is to be divided, real fixed phrases and real arithmetic relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁语「应当被分掉者」、真实固定搭配与真实算术同族词。

normal.en: The word is the thing to be divided, which explains both the arithmetic and the financial senses.
normal.cn: 这个词就是「要被分掉的东西」，这同时解释了算术义与金融义。

normal.en: Profit is cut into portions, and each share receives one portion.
normal.cn: 利润被切成几份，每一股得到其中一份。

normal.en: Insurance surplus and cooperative surplus are divided the same way among the people who funded them.
normal.cn: 保险盈余与合作社盈余也按同样方式在出资人之间分配。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the finance sense: dividend yield, cash dividend, stock dividend.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出金融义：股息收益率、现金股息、股票股利。

normal.en: The phrase pay dividends keeps the metaphor alive: effort is an investment that can return a portion.
normal.cn: 「产生回报」这一说法保留了比喻：努力是一项能返回一份的投资。

examples.cn: 股东们在年度会议上批准了更高的股息。

examples.en: Patience with the new process paid dividends within a year.
examples.cn: 对新流程的耐心在一年内带来了回报。

examples.en: In the expression forty divided by eight, forty is the dividend.
examples.cn: 在四十除以八这个算式中，四十是被除数。

root: 拉丁语 dividere「分开、分配」的动形词 dividendum「应当被分掉的东西」；先用于算术的被除数，十七世纪起用于分给股东的利润份额。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all depend on division: a profit is cut into portions, a scheduled payment is named by its timing, the benefit spreads beyond money, and arithmetic keeps the oldest literal sense.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都依赖「分开」：利润被切成几份，按支付时点得名，好处超出金钱，而算术保留了最古老的字面义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a money bag split into small bags for the people who own the company.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只钱袋被分成小袋，交给拥有公司的人。

branches.en: CORE SHARE: profit is divided, and one portion follows each share.
branches.cn: 核心份额：利润被分开，每一股跟随一份。

branches.en: FORMS OF PAYMENT: the same portion can be interim or final, paid in cash or issued as shares.
branches.cn: 支付形式：同一份可以是期中或期末，以现金支付或以股份发放。

branches.en: BENEFIT: the divided portion becomes any good result that effort returns.
branches.cn: 好处：被分出的份额变成努力返回的任何好结果。

branches.en: ARITHMETIC: the quantity that is to be divided keeps the oldest literal meaning.
branches.cn: 算术：应当被除的那个量保留了最古老的字面义。

branches.en: OTHER SURPLUS: insurers and cooperatives divide surplus among policyholders and members.
branches.cn: 其他盈余：保险公司与合作社在保单持有人与成员之间分配盈余。

senses.title: Belonging to a god
senses.definition: of, from or like a god
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）属于神、来自神或似神的
senses.example: The temple was built for divine worship.
senses.exampleCN: 这座庙是为敬神而建的。
senses.why: A shaft of light falling on a stone altar.
senses.whyCN: 一道落在石祭坛上的光柱。

senses.title: Holy and sacred
senses.definition: treated as holy and beyond ordinary life
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）被视为神圣、超乎日常生活的
senses.example: They promised to honour the divine law.

senses.title: Extremely good

intro.en: Divine comes from Latin divinus, belonging to a god, from divus, godlike; what belongs to a god is holy, and what is holy feels wonderful, so the word slid into praise.
intro.cn: divine 来自拉丁语 divinus「属于神的」，源自 divus「似神的」；属于神的就是神圣的，神圣的东西让人觉得美妙，于是这个词滑进了赞叹语。

items.en: Latin divus means godlike or divine.

items.en: Divinus means belonging to a god.

items.en: Old French divin carries both holy and wonderful senses.

items.en: The noun comes to name a scholar of theology.

items.en: Divine is also a warm word for something delightful.
items.cn: divine 也成了形容极美妙事物的亲热说法。

note.cn: divine 是属于神的；形近词共用「神」的词根或词形，近义词则是别的神圣与美的程度。

intro.en: Division is Latin divisio, a parting, from dividere, to force apart.
intro.cn: division 是拉丁语 divisio（分开），来自 dividere（强行拆开）。

items.en: Dividere meant to part what was joined.
items.cn: dividere 指把连在一起的东西分开。

items.en: Divisio named the act and the line it left.
items.cn: divisio 指分开的动作与留下的界线。

items.en: A divisio also meant a share given to an heir.
items.cn: divisio 也指分给继承人的一份。

items.en: English used it for splitting and for shares.
items.cn: 英语借入后指切开与分得的一份。

items.en: Army and trade gave it the sense of a unit.
items.cn: 军队与商业给了它「单位」的意思。

items.en: Today a division can be a sum, a team or a quarrel.
items.cn: 今天一个 division 可以是一道除法、一个团队或一场争执。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the dividere stem, while the meaning group names other kinds of parting.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dividere 这段词干，近义组则是几种分开的名目。

dict_mnemonic.text: dizziness ＝ dizzy（头晕的）＋ -ness（名词后缀，表示状态）＝「头晕的状态」。dizzy 在古英语里原本指「愚蠢」，后来才转成「站不稳、天旋地转」，所以这个词既管身体也管忙乱。

root: 古英语 dysig（愚蠢）→ 中古英语 dizy → 英语 dizzy ＋ -ness → dizziness

branches.en: Height makes the ground swim.

intro.en: Dizziness is dizzy plus -ness; the adverb adds -ily, while the Latin turn root vert- builds vertigo, a cousin in meaning.

latinIntro.en: Latin vertere means to turn and vertigo a whirling; the English stem dizzy is native, not Latin.

definition_zh: adj. 眩晕的；头晕的；令人眩晕的；眼花缭乱的；（旧）愚蠢的
definition_en: feeling that everything is spinning, causing that feeling, or too fast for the mind to follow
core_image: 一张脸在地板似乎倾斜时变得苍白；一部玻璃电梯一层层往上升；夜里一片模糊的霓虹招牌与穿行的车流；一个戴着纸王冠咧嘴笑的宫廷弄臣
scene: 她起身太快，地板好像斜了过来，脸一下子白了。She felt dizzy when she stood up too fast.
sceneCN: 这里 dizzy 是「眩晕的」（第 1 个义项：觉得自己或房间在旋转）；句意：她起身太快，觉得一阵眩晕。图中可辨识物件：椅子、倾斜的地板、苍白的脸、扶住桌沿的手。

senses.title: Feeling the spin
senses.definition: having the feeling that you or the room is turning round
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）觉得自己或房间在旋转的
senses.example: She felt dizzy when she stood up too fast.
senses.exampleCN: 她起身太快，觉得一阵眩晕。
senses.why: A face going pale as the floor seems to lean.
senses.whyCN: 一张脸在地板似乎倾斜时变得苍白。

senses.title: Making you unsteady
senses.definition: causing people to feel unsteady or giddy
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）使人站不稳或头晕的
senses.example: The dizzy height of the tower frightened the visitors.
senses.exampleCN: 塔楼令人眩晕的高度吓住了游客。
senses.why: A glass lift rising past floor after floor.
senses.whyCN: 一部玻璃电梯一层层往上升。

senses.title: Too fast to follow
senses.definition: so fast or busy that the mind cannot keep up
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）快到或忙到脑子跟不上的
senses.example: The dizzy pace of the city wore her out.
senses.exampleCN: 城市令人眼花缭乱的节奏把她累垮了。
senses.why: A blur of neon signs and crossing traffic at night.
senses.whyCN: 夜里一片模糊的霓虹招牌与穿行的车流。

senses.title: Silly in older use
senses.definition: foolish or stupid, in older English
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）在旧式英语里指愚蠢的
senses.example: The old tale calls the prince a dizzy youth.
senses.exampleCN: 那个老故事称王子是个傻小子。
senses.why: A grinning court jester wearing a paper crown.
senses.whyCN: 一个戴着纸王冠、咧嘴笑的宫廷弄臣。

intro.en: Dizzy descends from Old English dysig, foolish; a muddled head and a spinning head felt like the same thing, so by the sixteenth century the word had turned to giddy.
intro.cn: dizzy 源自古英语 dysig「愚蠢」；糊涂的脑袋与旋转的脑袋感觉像是同一回事，所以到十六世纪这个词已转成「头晕」。

items.en: Old English dysig meant foolish or stupid.
items.cn: 古英语 dysig 意为愚蠢的。

items.en: Middle English dizy still meant foolish.
items.cn: 中古英语 dizy 仍意为愚蠢的。

items.en: The sense shifts from foolish to giddy.
items.cn: 词义从「愚蠢」转向「头晕」。

items.en: Dizzy comes to describe heights that make you unsteady.
items.cn: dizzy 转而形容使人站不稳的高度。

items.en: Dizzy also describes a pace too fast to follow.
items.cn: dizzy 也形容快到跟不上的节奏。

note.en: Dizzy is a spinning head; its look-alikes share the stem or the idea of stunned senses, and its neighbours name nearby kinds of unsteadiness.
note.cn: dizzy 是旋转的脑袋；形近词共用词干或「感官发懵」的意思，近义词则是相近的几种站不稳。

definition_zh: n. 码头；船坞；被告席 v. 靠码头；进港；剪短；扣除
definition_en: a place where ships load, repair or stand trial, or to bring a ship in, cut a part off, or deduct money
core_image: 一条用粗缆绳系在石砌码头边的船身；一条架在墩木上停在空水池里的船；一个面向高台的木栏小隔间；一张被红笔划掉一行的工资单
scene: 渡轮贴上石砌码头，缆绳套上了系船柱。The ferry docked at noon.
sceneCN: 这里 dock 是「靠码头」（第 4 个义项：把船开进码头）；句意：渡轮中午靠岸。图中可辨识物件：渡轮、石砌码头、系船柱、粗缆绳。

senses.title: A ship berth
senses.definition: an enclosed area of water where ships load and unload
senses.definitionCN: （名词）供船只装卸货物的封闭水域
senses.example: The ship waited at the dock for a berth.
senses.exampleCN: 船在码头等泊位。
senses.why: A hull tied to a stone quay with thick ropes.
senses.whyCN: 一条用粗缆绳系在石砌码头边的船身。

senses.title: A repair yard
senses.definition: a place where ships are built or repaired
senses.definitionCN: （名词）造船或修船的地方
senses.example: The tanker went into dry dock for repairs.
senses.exampleCN: 油轮进干船坞修理。
senses.why: A ship resting on blocks in an empty basin.
senses.whyCN: 一条架在墩木上、停在空水池里的船。

senses.title: The trial place
senses.definition: the enclosed place where the accused stands in court
senses.definitionCN: （名词）法庭上被告站立的围栏区域
senses.example: He stood in the dock and said nothing.
senses.exampleCN: 他站在被告席上一言不发。
senses.why: A wooden rail box facing a raised bench.
senses.whyCN: 一个面向高台的木栏小隔间。

senses.title: Bring a ship in
senses.definition: to bring or take a ship into a dock
senses.definitionCN: （动词）把船开进或引进码头
senses.example: The ferry docked at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 渡轮中午靠岸。
senses.why: A rope looping over a bollard as the hull touches the quay.
senses.whyCN: 船身贴上码头时缆绳套上系船柱。

senses.title: Cut a part off
senses.definition: to cut off part of something, such as the tail of an animal
senses.definitionCN: （动词）剪掉某物的一部分，例如动物的尾巴
senses.example: The vet docked the tail of the lamb.
senses.exampleCN: 兽医剪短了羔羊的尾巴。
senses.why: A short tail stub beside a pair of shears.
senses.whyCN: 一把剪刀旁的一截短尾桩。

senses.title: Take money off
senses.definition: to deduct an amount from wages or a payment
senses.definitionCN: （动词）从工资或款项中减去一笔钱
senses.example: They docked his pay for the lost hours.
senses.exampleCN: 他们扣了他误工时数的工资。
senses.why: A payslip with one line crossed through in red.
senses.whyCN: 一张工资单，其中一行被红笔划掉。

intro.en: Dock comes from Middle Dutch docke, a channel or watercourse: first the water where a ship lies, then the quay beside it, then the railed box in court that looks like a small pen.
intro.cn: dock 来自中古荷兰语 docke「水道、沟渠」：先指船停的那片水，再指旁边的码头，后来法庭上那个像小围栏的被告席也叫这个名字。

items.en: Middle Dutch docke means a channel or watercourse.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 docke 意为水道或沟渠。

items.en: A related Low German word names a harbour basin.
items.cn: 相关的低地德语词指港口水池。

items.en: English dock first names the water where ships lie.
items.cn: 英语 dock 最初指船只停泊的水域。

items.en: The verb means to bring a ship into dock.
items.cn: 动词意为把船引进码头。

items.en: The word comes to name the enclosure for the accused.
items.cn: 这个词转而指被告所在的围栏区。

items.en: Dock also means to cut short or to deduct.
items.cn: dock 也指剪短或扣除。

note.en: Dock is where a ship lies still; its look-alikes share the stem or the ship setting, and its neighbours name other structures at the water edge.
note.cn: dock 是船停住的地方；形近词共用词干或同属船上场景，近义词则是水边别的构筑物。

definition_zh: 博士的；博士学位的；博士研究的
definition_en: relating to a doctorate, the highest university degree, or to the research and students connected with it
core_image: 一顶博士帽压在一摞改过无数遍的论文上
scene: 答辩室的灯亮到深夜，桌上摊着改得密密麻麻的稿子。She finally finished her doctoral dissertation after six years of fieldwork.
sceneCN: 这里 doctoral 是「博士研究的」（第 2 个义项：与博士论文和博士研究有关）；句意是她做了六年田野调查后终于完成了博士论文。

pos.zh: 博士的；博士学位的；博士研究的

senses.title: Relating to a doctorate
senses.definition: relating to the highest university degree, which is awarded after original research
senses.definitionCN: 与最高一级大学学位有关的，该学位须在原创研究之后授予
senses.example: A doctoral degree usually takes at least three years.
senses.exampleCN: 博士学位通常至少需要三年。
senses.why: Latin doctor meant teacher, and the suffix -al turns that title into an adjective of belonging, so the degree is named after the teacher it certifies.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 doctor 是「教师」，后缀 -al 把这个称号变成表示归属的形容词；这个学位正是以它所要认证的教师身份来命名的。

senses.title: Relating to dissertation research
senses.definition: connected with the original research and dissertation required for a doctorate
senses.definitionCN: 与取得博士学位所需的原创研究和学位论文有关的
senses.example: Her doctoral work examined how coastal soils change over time.
senses.exampleCN: 她的博士研究工作考察了沿海土壤随时间发生的变化。
senses.why: Research is the substance of the degree, so the same adjective naturally describes the long investigation behind the thesis.
senses.whyCN: 研究是这一学位的实质内容，因此同一个形容词自然也能描述论文背后那场漫长的调查。

senses.title: Relating to a doctoral candidate
senses.definition: used to describe a student who is working toward a doctorate
senses.definitionCN: 用来描述正在攻读博士学位的学生
senses.example: Doctoral candidates must defend their findings before a committee.
senses.exampleCN: 博士生必须在委员会面前为自己的研究成果答辩。
senses.why: The person is named after the degree still being earned, so one adjective covers both the title and the reader for it.

intro.en: Doctoral is built on Latin doctor, a teacher, plus the English adjective suffix -al.
intro.cn: doctoral 由拉丁语 doctor（教师）加英语形容词后缀 -al 构成。

items.en: The teaching verb behind Latin docere is usually traced to a root meaning to take or accept; the deeper origin is source uncertain.
items.cn: 拉丁语 docere 背后的「教」义一般追溯到表示「拿取、接受」的词根，更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Docere meant to teach or to show, and it also produced doctrina, teaching, and doctor.
items.cn: docere 意为「教、示范」，它还生出 doctrina（教导）与 doctor。

items.en: Doctor was an agent noun meaning teacher, and in the universities it became a title for a learned master.
items.cn: doctor 是施事名词，意为「教师」；在大学里逐渐成为博学之士的头衔。

items.en: Doctoratus named the degree of a doctor; the earliest university records are from the thirteenth century, though exact dates are uncertain.
items.cn: doctoratus 指博士的学位；最早的大学记录出现在十三世纪，确切年代仍有争议。

items.en: English formed doctoral from doctor plus -al to describe anything belonging to the degree.
items.cn: 英语用 doctor 加 -al 造出 doctoral，用来描述属于这一学位的事物。

items.en: The adjective spread from degrees to dissertations, research projects and candidates.
items.cn: 这个形容词从学位扩展到论文、研究项目以及在读的候选人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin teaching root; the near-meaning group gathers other academic labels.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语「教」这个词根；近义组收的是其他学术称谓。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open catechism on a lectern in a dim church beside a signed policy paper pinned to a cabinet wall
core.cn: 核心意象：昏暗教堂里读经台上一本摊开的教理问答，旁边是一份钉在内阁墙上的签署政策文件

branches.en: What a church hands on as belief.
branches.cn: 教会作为信仰传下来的东西。

branches.en: What a state puts forward as policy.
branches.cn: 国家作为政策提出的东西。

branches.en: What a field accepts as teaching.
branches.cn: 某学科作为学说接受的东西。

branches.en: What is applied without question.
branches.cn: 不加质疑就套用的东西。

branches.en: Both are beliefs held firmly and taught.
branches.cn: 两者都是被坚信并传授的信念。

intro.en: Doctrine is the teach root doc- plus -ine; the same root builds doctor and docile, while -al gives doctrinal and in- gives indoctrinate.
intro.cn: doctrine 由「教」的词根 doc- 加 -ine 构成；同一个词根造出 doctor 与 docile，-al 给出 doctrinal，in- 给出 indoctrinate。

latinIntro.en: Latin docere means to teach and doctrina teaching; Greek dogma means an opinion or decree, and Latin credere to believe.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 docere 意为教，doctrina 意为教导；希腊语 dogma 意为意见或法令，拉丁语 credere 意为相信。

definition_zh: 文件；公文；证件；记录，用文件证明；电子文档
definition_en: a written, printed or electronic record that gives information or proof, or to record something in a permanent form
core_image: 一叠盖章的纸，把发生过的事固定下来
scene: 移民官把一摞材料推到窗口前，逐页翻看。Please bring every document needed for the visa interview.
sceneCN: 这里 document 是「文件、材料」（第 1 个义项：提供信息或证据的书面记录）；句意是请带上签证面谈所需的全部文件。

pos.zh: 文件；公文；证件；电子文档

derivatives.zh: 文件资料；证明材料；文档编制

senses.title: A written record
senses.definition: a piece of written, printed or electronic matter that provides information or evidence
senses.definitionCN: 提供信息或证据的书面、印刷或电子材料
senses.example: The historian found a document describing the old harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 历史学家找到了一份描述旧港口的文件。
senses.why: Latin documentum was a lesson or a proof, something that teaches because it shows the facts.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 documentum 是「教训、凭证」，它之所以能教人，是因为把事实摆了出来。

senses.title: An official paper
senses.definition: an official paper such as a passport, certificate or contract that proves identity, rights or an agreement
senses.definitionCN: 护照、证书或合同等官方纸张，用来证明身份、权利或协议
senses.example: No one may enter the site without the proper documents.
senses.exampleCN: 没有正式证件，任何人不得进入该场地。
senses.why: When a record carries a stamp or a signature, it stops being private notes and becomes proof that others must accept.
senses.whyCN: 当一份记录盖上印章或签上名字，它就不再是私人笔记，而成了别人必须承认的凭证。

senses.title: To record something
senses.definition: to record an event, a process or a fact in writing, photographs or another lasting form
senses.definitionCN: 用文字、照片或其他持久形式记录事件、过程或事实
senses.example: The team documented every step of the experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 团队记录了实验的每一个步骤。
senses.why: The noun turns into an action: facts are fixed on paper so that later readers can check them.
senses.whyCN: 名词变成动作：把事实固定在纸上，好让后来的人可以核对。

senses.title: A computer file
senses.definition: a file created by a word processor or similar program, containing text and often images
senses.definitionCN: 由文字处理软件或类似程序创建、含文字并常含图片的文件
senses.example: Save the document before you close the programme.
senses.exampleCN: 关闭程序前请先保存这份文档。
senses.why: The paper record moved onto a screen, but the name stayed because the purpose is the same: a fixed body of text to return to.
senses.whyCN: 纸张上的记录搬到了屏幕上，但名称留了下来，因为用途没变：一份可以反复调取的固定文本。

intro.en: Document goes back to Latin documentum, a lesson or a proof, built on docere, to teach.
intro.cn: document 可追溯到拉丁语 documentum（教训、凭证），其根是 docere（教）。

items.en: Docere meant to teach or to show, and it produced doctor and doctrina as well.
items.cn: docere 意为「教、显示」，它还生出 doctor 与 doctrina。

items.en: Documentum meant a lesson, a warning or a piece of evidence, something that shows what is true.
items.cn: documentum 指教训、警示或证据，也就是能把真相摆出来的东西。

items.en: Old French document carried the legal and written senses into Middle English.
items.cn: 古法语 document 把法律与书面义带入中古英语。

items.en: The noun is recorded in English from the fourteenth century, first for an authoritative written record.
items.cn: 英语中这个名词自十四世纪有记录，最初指有权威性的书面记录。

items.en: The verb to document, meaning to support with evidence, became common in travel and science writing.
items.cn: 动词 document 表示「以证据支持」，在游记与科学写作中逐渐常见。

items.en: The computer age added the electronic file to the family without changing the core idea of a fixed record.
items.cn: 计算机时代把电子文件加进这一族，却没有改变「固定记录」的核心意思。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the Latin doc root; the near-meaning group gathers other kinds of written proof.
note.cn: 形近组守着拉丁语 doc 词根；近义组收的是其他种类的书面凭证。

entries.definition: Written material that records or supports something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「文件记录、证明材料」，与本词共享 doc 词根。

entries.definition: A factual film or programme, or an adjective meaning based on records.
entries.definitionCN: 名词指「纪录片」，形容词指「纪实的、文件的」，同出本词。

entries.definition: A holder of the highest degree or a medical practitioner; it shares docere, to teach.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指博士或医生；与 document 同出拉丁语 docere（教）。

entries.definition: A collection of papers or data kept together under one name.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「档案、文件」，指归在同一名下的纸张或数据。

entries.definition: A written or stored account of facts; broader and less formal than document.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「记录」，范围为广、正式程度低于 document。

entries.definition: An official paper that proves a fact, such as a birth or a qualification.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「证书」，指证明出生、资格等事实的官方纸张。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real docere family and the everyday places documents appear.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子用真实的 docere 词族，以及文件实际出现的日常场景。

normal.en: Docere is to teach: a document teaches later readers what happened.
normal.cn: docere 是「教」：一份文件教后来的人知道发生过什么。

normal.en: Doctor, doctrine and document all come from the same teaching root.
normal.cn: doctor、doctrine 与 document 都出自同一个「教」的词根。

normal.en: A travel document is a passport or visa, not a diary.
normal.cn: travel document 指护照或签证，不是日记。

normal.en: The verb document appears in phrases such as document the process.
normal.cn: 动词 document 常见于 document the process 这类搭配。

normal.en: An electronic document keeps the old name because it is still a fixed text.
normal.cn: 电子文档沿用旧名，因为它仍然是固定下来的文本。

abstract.en: Picture a folder whose pages are pinned down by a heavy stamp.
abstract.cn: 想象一个文件夹，纸页被一枚沉重的印章压住。

abstract.en: Picture a camera beside a notebook, both recording the same event.
abstract.cn: 想象相机和笔记本并排放着，记录同一件事。

abstract.en: Picture a paper page sliding into a screen without losing its edges.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸滑进屏幕里，却没有失去自己的边界。

examples.en: Every claim in the report must be supported by a document.
examples.cn: 报告中的每一项说法都必须有文件支持。

examples.en: They documented the damage with photographs and measurements.
examples.cn: 他们用照片和测量数据记录了受损情况。

examples.en: She opened the document and began to edit the first paragraph.
examples.cn: 她打开文档，开始修改第一段。

dict_mnemonic.text: doc 有「教、示」的意思，-ment 是名词后缀：把事实摆出来教给别人看，就是一份文件。

root: 源自拉丁语 documentum（教训、证据、范例），由 docere（教、显示）加名词后缀 -mentum 构成；docere 同时生出 doctor 与 doctrina。古法语 document 把书面与法律义带入英语，动词用法在十八世纪普及。

sensesIntro.en: From a written record to an official proof, an act of recording, and finally a file on a screen.
sensesIntro.cn: 从书面记录，到官方凭证，再到记录这一动作，最后落到屏幕上的电子文件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of stamped pages that pins down what happened.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠盖了章的纸页，把发生过的事固定住。

branches.en: THE RECORD: written matter that carries information from one reader to the next.
branches.cn: 记录线：把信息从一位读者传给下一位读者的书面材料。

branches.en: THE STAMP: official marks turn a record into proof of identity or rights.
branches.cn: 印章线：官方标记把记录变成身份或权利的证明。

branches.en: THE ACT: the verb names the work of fixing facts in a lasting form.
branches.cn: 动作线：动词指把事实固定成持久形式的工作。

branches.en: THE SCREEN: the same fixed text now lives in a computer file.
branches.cn: 屏幕线：同一份固定文本如今住在电脑文件里。

branches.en: Private notes and official papers share one word because both preserve what was said.
branches.cn: 私人笔记与官方文书共用一个词，因为两者都保存了所说过的话。

intro.en: Document is a Latin noun whose suffix -mentum names a result; English adds further suffixes for its family.
intro.cn: document 是拉丁语名词，后缀 -mentum 表示结果；英语再用其他后缀扩展这一族。

latinIntro.en: Latin docere, documentum and doctrina are all recorded, so only the deeper root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 docere、documentum 与 doctrina 均有记录，只有更早的词根属于重构。

items.example: The root verb means to show the facts.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根动词表示把事实摆出来。

items.example: The Latin noun already meant a piece of evidence.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词本义就是一件证据。

items.meaning: result or means of an action
items.example: It carries the result sense of documentum.
items.exampleCN: 它承接了 documentum 表示结果的含义。

items.example: The film is documentary in style.
items.exampleCN: 这部影片是纪实风格的。

items.meaning: the act or body of recording
items.exampleCN: 良好的记录能省下以后的时间。
许多工人仍没有正式证件。

definition_zh: 纪录片；纪实的；文献的
definition_en: a film or programme that gives facts about real people and events
core_image: 摄影机对准真实发生的现场
scene: 晚自习结束后，班里的投影幕布亮起，老师按下播放键。The class watched a documentary about wild pandas.
sceneCN: 这里 documentary 是「纪录片」（第 1 个义项：讲真实事实的影片）；句意：全班观看了一部关于野生大熊猫的纪录片。

senses.title: A film of real facts
senses.definition: a film or programme giving facts about real life
senses.definitionCN: 讲述真实生活事实的电影或节目
senses.example: The documentary follows whales across the ocean.
senses.exampleCN: 这部纪录片追踪鲸鱼横渡大洋。
senses.why: The word is built on document: the film is treated as a moving paper of evidence.
senses.whyCN: 这个词建立在 document 之上：影片被当作一页会动的证据纸。

senses.title: Based on written records
senses.definition: based on or using documents
senses.definitionCN: 基于文件或使用文献的
senses.example: The film used documentary evidence from the war.
senses.exampleCN: 影片引用了战争时期的书面证据。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the paper sense: proof still comes from documents.
senses.whyCN: 形容词保留纸张义：证据仍来自文献。

intro.en: Documentary grew straight out of document, the paper that teaches.
intro.cn: documentary 直接从 document（教导人的纸张）中生长出来。

items.en: Latin documentum meant lesson, from docere to teach.
items.cn: 拉丁语 documentum 意为课程，来自 docere（教导）。

items.en: French document passed on the paper sense.
items.cn: 法语 document 传下了「文件」之义。

items.en: English document settled as written proof.
items.cn: 英语 document 定型为书面证据。

items.en: French film documentaire named factual films in the early twentieth century.
items.cn: 二十世纪初，法语 film documentaire 用来命名纪实影片。

items.en: English documentary became the standard word for factual film.
items.cn: 英语 documentary 成为纪实影片的标准用词。

note.en: These words sit near documentary in form or meaning.
note.cn: 这些词在形式或意义上与 documentary 相邻。

normalIntro.en: Use the camera-on-fact picture and the document family.
normalIntro.cn: 用「镜头对准事实」的画面和 document 词族来记。

normal.en: watch a documentary is the common phrase in class.
normal.cn: watch a documentary 是课堂常见说法。

normal.en: documentary is document plus film.
normal.cn: documentary 就是 document 加影片。

normal.en: A nature documentary films real animals.
normal.cn: 自然纪录片拍摄真实动物。

normal.en: documentary evidence is written proof, not film.
normal.cn: documentary evidence 指书面证据而非影片。

normal.en: documentaries tell true stories without actors.
normal.cn: documentaries 讲真事，不用演员演戏。

abstract.en: Hear the soft hum of the camera following the herd.
abstract.cn: 听摄影机跟随兽群时轻微的嗡鸣。

abstract.en: See rain on the lens as the explorer walks on.
abstract.cn: 看雨点落在探险者前行镜头的镜片上。

abstract.en: Feel the quiet truth of a voice reading dates.
abstract.cn: 感受旁白念出年份时的静穆真实。

examples.en: The students made a short documentary about their town.
examples.cn: 学生们拍了一部关于家乡小镇的短片纪录片。

examples.en: A documentary about volcanoes is on tonight.
examples.cn: 今晚有一部关于火山的纪录片。

examples.en: She gave documentary proof of her studies abroad.
examples.cn: 她出示了海外学习的书面证明。

sensesIntro.en: Documentary names factual films and, as an adjective, anything built on documents.
sensesIntro.cn: documentary 作名词指纪实影片，作形容词指基于文献的东西。

intro.cn: documentary 是 document 词族里带影片色彩的一员。

latinIntro.en: The root is Latin docere, to teach.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是拉丁语 docere（教导）。

definition_en: the act of recording something in documents, the body of documents so produced, and the evidence or instructions those documents provide
core_image: 一叠盖章的纸被逐页归档，每页都能证明上一页说过的话
scene: 把镜头拉近到这样一个场景：The clerk stamped each page and filed it, so that the shipment's documentation could be checked at the border.
sceneCN: 这里 documentation 是「随货文件、证明材料」（第 3 个义项：证明文件）；句意：职员给每页盖章并归档，以便这批货物在边境受检时能出示文件。图中可辨识物件：成叠的纸页、印章、档案柜、货箱、边境检查窗口。

senses.title: The body of documents: papers taken as a whole
senses.titleCN: 文件整体：把一批文件当作一个集合
senses.definition: the collected documents that relate to a subject, person, or event
senses.definitionCN: 与某一主题、人物或事件相关的一批文件的总称
senses.example: The archive holds the documentation of the entire expedition.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆保存着整次探险的全部文件。
senses.why: Latin documentum meant 'lesson, proof, warning', from docere 'to teach'. A set of such papers teaches later readers what happened; -ation gathers the papers into one mass noun.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 documentum 意为“教训、证据、警示”，出自 docere“教”。这样一组纸页向后来的读者“讲述”发生了什么；-ation 把这些纸页聚成一个集合名词。

senses.title: The act of documenting: recording step by step
senses.titleCN: 记录行为：逐步把过程写下来
senses.definition: the process of recording facts, decisions, or procedures in written or digital form
senses.definitionCN: 用书面或数字形式记录事实、决定或流程的过程
senses.example: Careful documentation of each trial made the results reproducible.
senses.exampleCN: 对每次试验的仔细记录使结果可以复现。
senses.why: -ation is an action-noun suffix from Latin -ationem. The word therefore names not only the papers but the deliberate act of producing them, which is why it appears in research methods.
senses.whyCN: -ation 是出自拉丁语 -ationem 的动作名词后缀。因此这个词不只指纸页，也指有意产出纸页的行为，这就是它常出现在研究方法中的原因。

senses.title: Proof papers: what you show an official
senses.titleCN: 证明文件：递给官员查验的那一套
senses.definition: official papers that establish identity, ownership, or compliance
senses.definitionCN: 用来证明身份、所有权或合规性的官方文件
senses.example: Without proper documentation, the goods could not cross the border.
senses.exampleCN: 没有齐全的文件，货物无法过境。
senses.why: This is documentum's 'proof' sense made concrete. A document is evidence because it can be shown; documentation is the bundle you hand over when someone has the right to ask.
senses.whyCN: 这是 documentum“证据”义的落实。文件之所以是证据，是因为它可以被出示；documentation 就是当别人有权查验时你递过去的那一叠。

senses.title: Software documentation: instructions for users and maintainers
senses.titleCN: 软件文档：给用户和维护者的说明
senses.definition: manuals, references, and notes explaining how software is used or built
senses.definitionCN: 说明软件如何使用或如何构建的手册、参考与注记
senses.example: The library is good, but its documentation is out of date.
senses.exampleCN: 这个库不错，但它的文档已经过时。
senses.why: Programming borrowed the word in the mid-20th century. Here documents teach two different readers: users how to operate, maintainers how the code is organised.
senses.whyCN: 编程领域在 20 世纪中期借用了这个词。这里的文档在教两类读者：用户如何操作，维护者如何理解代码结构。

senses.title: Procedure records: written steps that keep work consistent
senses.titleCN: 流程记录：让工作保持一致的书面条文
senses.definition: written descriptions of agreed procedures, used to keep work repeatable and auditable
senses.definitionCN: 对已商定流程的书面描述，用于使工作可重复、可审计
senses.example: The lab's documentation specifies exactly how each sample is stored.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室的流程文件明确规定了每个样本的存放方式。
senses.why: Once the papers are meant to guide future action rather than prove past action, documentation becomes an operating instrument. The same noun now points forward.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这些纸页是用来指导未来行动而非证明过去行动，documentation 就成了操作工具。同一个名词由此指向未来。

senses.title: Historical record: the trace a period leaves behind
senses.titleCN: 历史记录：一个时代留下的痕迹
senses.definition: the surviving written material by which a period or practice is known
senses.definitionCN: 后人据以了解某一时期或某种做法的存世书面材料
senses.example: The documentation of the old guild is fragmentary but revealing.
senses.exampleCN: 这个古老行会的存世记录虽然零碎，却很有揭示力。
senses.why: historians use documentation for what survives rather than what was written deliberately for them. The word shifts from a product of an office to the raw material of a discipline.
senses.whyCN: 历史学家用 documentation 指存留下来的材料，而不是专为他们写的东西。词义从“办公室的产物”转为“一个学科的原料”。

senses.title: Clinical charting: the patient's written trail
senses.titleCN: 病案记录：病人的书面轨迹
senses.definition: the ongoing written record of a patient's condition, treatment, and consent
senses.definitionCN: 对病人病情、治疗与知情同意所作的持续书面记录
senses.example: Poor documentation of the dosage led to a review of the ward.
senses.exampleCN: 剂量记录不完整，导致该病区接受了复查。
senses.why: In medicine the proof sense becomes legal and ethical: if it was not documented, it cannot be defended. The noun carries both the care given and the evidence that it was given.
senses.whyCN: 在医学中，“证据”义带上法律与伦理色彩：没有记录就无法自证。这个名词既承载所给的照护，也承载“确实给过”的证据。

senses.title: Legal paperwork: contracts and filings
senses.titleCN: 法律文件：合同与备案材料
senses.definition: the contracts, deeds, and filings required to make a transaction or status legally valid
senses.definitionCN: 使交易或身份在法律上成立所需的合同、契据与备案材料
senses.example: The merger stalled until the documentation was signed in full.
senses.exampleCN: 直到全部文件签署完毕，合并才得以推进。
senses.why: Here the papers do not merely record the deal; they constitute it. Latin documentum already mixed 'proof' with 'formal instrument', and law keeps both at once.
senses.whyCN: 这里的文件不只是记录交易，而是构成交易。拉丁语 documentum 本就把“证据”与“正式文书”混在一起，法律同时保留了这两层。

intro.en: Documentation is document plus -ation, built in English on the Latin noun documentum. The root verb is docere 'to teach', which also gives doctor, doctrine and docile. The exact date of the English noun is not fixed, so the late-18th-century dating below is approximate.
intro.cn: documentation 是 document 加 -ation，在英语里以拉丁名词 documentum 为基础构成。其根动词是 docere“教”，也给出 doctor、doctrine、docile。英语名词的确切年代没有定论，下面所标 18 世纪后期只是大致估计。

items.en: Software documentation becomes a fixed term, and the word is routinely used for online manuals and API references.
items.cn: 软件文档成为固定术语，这个词开始日常用于在线手册与 API 参考。

items.en: Computing and engineering adopt documentation for written specifications, splitting user documents from maintenance documents.
items.cn: 计算机与工程领域采用 documentation 指书面规范，并把用户文档与维护文档区分开。

items.en: The English noun documentation is recorded in the sense 'the act or result of documenting'; the dating here is approximate.
items.cn: 英语名词 documentation 以“记录的行为或结果”义见于记载；此处年代为大致估计。

items.en: Latin documentum means 'lesson, proof, warning', an instrument that teaches or convinces. The suffix -mentum marks a means or result, so a document is literally 'that by which one is taught'.
items.cn: 拉丁语 documentum 意为“教训、证据、警示”，是一种用来教导或说服的工具。后缀 -mentum 表示手段或结果，因此 document 字面上就是“借以受教之物”。

items.en: docere 'to teach' is generally referred to PIE *dek- 'to take, accept', also seen in Latin decus 'honour' and discere 'to learn'. The reconstruction is standard but indirect.
items.cn: docere“教”一般认为出自原始印欧语 *dek-“接受、接纳”，也见于拉丁语 decus“荣誉”与 discere“学习”。这一重构是通行的，但属于间接推定，*dek- 为重构形式。

note.en: The first group separates true relatives from spelling neighbours; the second compares words that only partially overlap in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组把真正的同族词与只是撞形的词分开；第二组比较只有部分含义重叠的词。

entries.definition: a doctrine accepted without question. It comes from Greek dogma, from dokein 'to seem, think', not from Latin docere 'to teach'.
entries.definitionCN: 不加质疑即接受的教条。它出自希腊语 dogma，源于 dokein“显得、认为”，与拉丁语 docere“教”无关。

entries.definition: a learned person or physician. Latin doctor is 'one who teaches', from docere; the medical sense came later through 'teacher of medicine'.
entries.definitionCN: 博学之人；医生。拉丁语 doctor 就是“教导者”，出自 docere；医学义后来才由“医学的教师”引申而来。

entries.definition: easy to teach or manage. It comes from docilis 'teachable', also from docere, but it names a temperament rather than a record.
entries.definitionCN: 易教、易管教的。它出自 docilis“可教的”，同样源于 docere，但指性情而非记录。

entries.definition: any stored account of facts. It is broader than documentation and may be spoken, visual, or written.
entries.definitionCN: 任何被保存的事实记述。它比 documentation 宽泛，可以是口述的、影像的或书面的。

entries.definition: the routine forms and letters an office must handle. It stresses tedium and bureaucracy, where documentation stresses content and proof.
entries.definitionCN: 办公室必须处理的例行表格与信件。它强调繁琐与官僚气，而 documentation 强调内容与凭证。

entries.definition: material that supports a claim. Documentation can serve as evidence, but evidence may be physical or testimonial.
entries.definitionCN: 支持某一主张的材料。documentation 可以充当证据，但证据也可以是实物或证言。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: documentation is document plus -ation, the same -ation that turns record into an action-noun.
normal.cn: documentation 是 document 加 -ation，正是把动词变成动作名词的那个 -ation。

normal.en: The root docere 'to teach' also gives doctor, doctrine and docile; a document is something that teaches you what happened.
normal.cn: 词根 docere“教”还给出 doctor、doctrine、docile；document 就是教你“发生了什么”的东西。

normal.en: -mentum in documentum is a means-or-result suffix, so a document is 'that by which one is taught or convinced'.
normal.cn: documentum 里的 -mentum 是表示手段或结果的后缀，所以 document 就是“借以受教或被说服之物”。

normal.en: Documentation and dogma look alike but split at the root: docere teaches, dokein merely seems.
normal.cn: documentation 与 dogma 形似却词根不同：docere 是“教”，dokein 只是“显得”。

normal.en: In software, documentation teaches two readers at once: the user who operates and the maintainer who rebuilds.
normal.cn: 在软件里，documentation 同时教两类读者：操作它的用户和维护它的开发者。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of stamped pages: each page is a small teacher standing behind the one before it.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠盖章的纸页：每一页都是站在前一页身后的一个小老师。

abstract.en: The same stack can be proof at a border, a manual on a desk, a chart in a ward, or a deed in a lawyer's file.
abstract.cn: 同一叠纸可以在边境是证明，在桌上是手册，在病房是病案，在律师的卷宗里是契据。

abstract.en: Every sense asks the same question: what does this paper teach the next reader, and who has the right to ask?
abstract.cn: 每个义项都在问同一个问题：这张纸教给下一位读者什么，又是谁有权来查验？

examples.en: The researcher kept meticulous documentation of every measurement.
examples.cn: 研究者对每一次测量都做了细致的记录。

examples.en: Customs officers refused the shipment for lack of documentation.
examples.cn: 海关人员因文件不全而拒绝放行这批货物。

examples.en: Read the documentation before you upgrade the database.
examples.cn: 升级数据库之前请先阅读文档。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「多 Q 门头写生」——多开几道门头，把每笔都写生记下 → documentation 文档、记录

root: 拉丁语 documentum“教训、证据、文书”＝docere“教”＋-mentum（手段／结果后缀）；documentation＝document＋-ation（动作或结果名词后缀）。核心是“把发生的事写下来，使其可教、可证”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses keep one image: papers that teach a later reader. What changes is the reader and the purpose — an archive, a method, a border officer, a user, a future shift, a historian, a doctor, a court.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一个意象：一叠纸在教后来的读者。变化的只是读者与用途——档案馆、研究方法、边境官员、软件用户、下一班同事、历史学家、医生、法庭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of stamped pages, each able to prove what the previous page said.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠盖章的纸页，每一页都能证明前一页说过的话。

branches.en: PAPERS AND THE ACT: the bundle and the deliberate writing that produced it are two faces of one noun.
branches.cn: 文件与行为：一整叠文件与产出它的有意书写，是同一个名词的两面。

branches.en: PROOF: the pages become evidence at the moment an authority has the right to demand them.
branches.cn: 凭证：当权威有权索取时，纸页就成了证据。

branches.en: INSTRUCTIONS: the same pages turn forward, telling users how to operate and staff how to repeat a procedure.
branches.cn: 说明：同一批纸页转向未来，告诉用户如何操作、员工如何复现流程。

branches.en: THE SURVIVING TRAIL: historians read what remains, clinicians read what was charted, and absence itself becomes information.
branches.cn: 留存的轨迹：历史学家读残存之物，医生读被记录之物，而“缺失”本身也成为信息。

branches.en: CONSTITUTING THE DEAL: in law the papers do not merely record the transaction; they make it valid.
branches.cn: 构成交易：在法律上，文件不只是记录交易，而是使交易生效。

intro.en: Documentation is document plus -ation, from Latin -ationem, an action-or-result suffix. English first borrowed document from Latin documentum, then built the longer noun on it.
intro.cn: documentation 是 document 加 -ation，后者出自拉丁语 -ationem，表示动作或结果。英语先借入 document（来自 documentum），再在它上面造出更长的名词。

latinIntro.en: The root is docere 'to teach', whose stem doc- appears in document, doctor, doctrine and docile. The suffix -mentum in documentum marks means or result.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 docere“教”，其词干 doc- 见于 document、doctor、doctrine、docile。documentum 中的 -mentum 表示手段或结果。

items.meaning: the act of recording, or the body of records produced
items.meaningCN: 记录行为，或由此形成的整套文件（-ation 构成动作／结果名词）
items.example: The documentation of the experiment filled three folders.
items.exampleCN: 这次实验的记录装满了三个文件夹。

items.meaning: a written instrument that records or proves something
items.meaningCN: 记录或证明某事的书面文书（-ment 表示手段／结果）
items.example: Please sign this document in the presence of a witness.
items.exampleCN: 请在见证人在场时签署这份文件。

items.meaning: based on documents, or a film built from recorded material
items.meaningCN: 以文件为据的；纪录片（-ary 构成形容词）
有书面记录的；有据可查的
items.example: The species is well documented in regional surveys.
items.exampleCN: 这个物种在区域调查中有充分记录。

items.meaning: lacking records, or lacking official papers
items.meaningCN: 无记录的；无合法证件的
items.example: Undocumented workers are vulnerable to exploitation.
items.exampleCN: 没有合法证件的工人容易遭受剥削。

items.meaning: one who teaches, later a learned or medical practitioner
items.meaningCN: 教导者；后指博士或医生（-tor 表示施动者）
items.example: She became a doctor of philosophy in 1998.
items.exampleCN: 她于 1998 年获得哲学博士学位。

items.meaning: a body of teaching held to be true
items.meaningCN: 被奉为正确的教义、学说
items.example: The party revised its economic doctrine.
items.exampleCN: 该党修订了其经济学说。

items.meaningCN: 可教的；顺从的（-ile 表示“能够被……”）
items.example: The docile horse accepted the new rider.
items.exampleCN: 这匹温顺的马接受了新骑手。

items.meaning: to teach a set of beliefs uncritically
items.meaningCN: 灌输（使人不加批判地接受一套信念）
items.example: The camp sought to indoctrinate its recruits.
items.exampleCN: 该营地试图向新成员灌输思想。

items.meaning: a dramatised film based on real records
items.meaningCN: 纪实剧情片（docu- 来自 document）
items.example: The docudrama blurred records and invention.
items.exampleCN: 这部纪实剧情片把记录与虚构混在一起。

latinEntries.meaning: to teach, to show, to instruct

definition_zh: adj. 教条的；武断的；固执己见的；教义的
definition_en: stating opinions as if they could not be questioned, or bound to a fixed set of beliefs

pos.zh: 教条的；武断的；固执己见的；教义的

senses.title: Asserting without proof
senses.definition: stating opinions firmly as if they were facts beyond question
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）把意见当成不容置疑的事实断然说出
senses.example: His dogmatic tone closed the discussion.
senses.exampleCN: 他武断的语气终结了讨论。
senses.why: A finger tapping a printed page while other hands stay raised.
senses.whyCN: 一根手指敲着印好的一页，而其他手还举着。

senses.title: Bound to a doctrine
senses.definition: following a fixed set of beliefs without allowing doubt
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）死守一套固定信念、不容怀疑的
senses.example: The dogmatic reading of the text ignored the evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 对文本的教条式解读无视了证据。
senses.why: A rulebook chained to a lectern in an old library.
senses.whyCN: 一本用链条锁在旧图书馆读经台上的规则书。

senses.title: Of church dogma
senses.definition: relating to the official dogma of a church
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）与教会正式教义有关的
senses.example: The council debated dogmatic questions for weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 会议就教义问题辩论了数周。
senses.why: A row of sealed decrees on a synod table.
senses.whyCN: 一排封好印的教令摆在宗教会议桌上。

senses.title: Refusing to listen
senses.definition: unwilling to consider the views of other people
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）不愿考虑别人看法的
senses.example: She grew dogmatic whenever the topic came up.
senses.exampleCN: 每当谈起这个话题她就变得固执己见。
senses.why: A man with folded arms turned away from a whiteboard.
senses.whyCN: 一个抱着双臂、背对白板的人。

intro.en: Dogmatic comes from Greek dogma, an opinion or decree, from dokein, to seem or think; what merely seemed true to one person was laid down as true for everyone.
intro.cn: dogmatic 来自希腊语 dogma「意见、法令」，源自 dokein「似乎、认为」；一个人觉得似乎为真的东西，被定为对所有人都为真。

items.en: Dokein means to seem or to think.
items.cn: dokein 意为似乎、认为。

items.en: Greek dogma means an opinion or a decree.
items.cn: 希腊语 dogma 意为意见或法令。

items.en: Dogmatikos means holding firm opinions.
items.cn: dogmatikos 意为坚持己见的。

items.en: Latin dogmaticus carries the sense of asserting doctrine.
items.cn: 拉丁语 dogmaticus 带有断言教义的意思。

items.en: English dogmatic first describes settled philosophical opinion.
items.cn: 英语 dogmatic 最初形容确定的哲学见解。

items.en: The word now usually criticises an unwillingness to listen.
items.cn: 这个词现在通常批评不愿倾听的态度。

note.en: Dogmatic is laying down an opinion as law; its look-alikes share the dogma stem or the opposite attitude, and its neighbours name nearby ways of holding a view.
note.cn: dogmatic 是把意见当成法令定下来；形近词共用 dogma 词干或指相反的态度，近义词则是相近的几种持见方式。

entries.definition: a principle laid down as unquestionably true
entries.definitionCN: 被断定为不容置疑的原则

entries.definition: the habit of asserting opinions rigidly
entries.definitionCN: 僵硬地断言己见的习惯

entries.definition: dealing with things by practical results
entries.definitionCN: 按实际效果处理事情的

entries.definition: holding firm views and stating them freely
entries.definitionCN: 持坚定看法并随意表达的

entries.definition: applying theory without regard to practice
entries.definitionCN: 不顾实际地套用理论的

entries.definition: confident in stating needs and views
entries.definitionCN: 自信地表达需求与看法的

dict_mnemonic.text: dogmatic ＝ dogma（教条、被断定为准的意见）＋ -tic（形容词后缀，表示「与…有关的」）＝「教条式的」。希腊语 dokein 是「认为」，认为得不容别人反驳，就成了武断；相反的态度是 pragmatic「讲实效的」。

root: 希腊语 dokein（认为）→ dogma（意见、法令）→ dogmatikos（坚持己见的）→ 拉丁语 dogmaticus → 英语 dogmatic

sensesIntro.en: An opinion laid down as law in four scenes: a tapping finger over raised hands, a chained rulebook, sealed decrees on a table and folded arms turned from a whiteboard.
sensesIntro.cn: 「意见被定成法令」的四个场景：举着的手上方敲纸的手指、锁住的规则书、桌上的封印第令与背对白板的抱臂。

intro.en: Dogmatic is dogma plus -tic; -ism gives dogmatism, -ist gives dogmatist and -ally gives dogmatically, while pragma builds the opposite pragmatic.
intro.cn: dogmatic 由 dogma 加 -tic 构成；-ism 给出 dogmatism，-ist 给出 dogmatist，-ally 给出 dogmatically，而 pragma 造出相反的 pragmatic。

latinIntro.en: Greek dokein means to seem, dogma an opinion or decree and pragma a deed; Latin dogmaticus carries the Greek sense into English.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 dokein 意为似乎，dogma 意为意见或法令，pragma 意为行为；拉丁语 dogmaticus 把希腊语的意思带进英语。

items.exampleCN: 教条主义者；现实主义者
